title: Keep the Assembly GL context current until its frame finishes
head: f899b75e113c4e7fdf422842c4403e9b62906bdd
body:
Returning from Assembly can exit Studio with X11 BadMatch (GLX SwapBuffers, opcode 11). The return button reloads Prepare immediately while Assembly is still rendering; both canvases share one GL context. This moves the context before the outgoing frame finishes.

Remove the premature reload. The existing posted view-switch event already reloads Prepare after leave_assemble_stack(), when Assembly edits have been copied back and its frame has completed.

Validation on Linux/XWayland, Mesa 26.1.6:
- Three independent baseline processes failed on their first Return; tracing showed Assembly being swapped while Prepare was current.
- An earlier fixed combined build completed five traced round trips: 202 swaps, ten drawable switches, zero mismatches and zero X errors. Five additional normal-launch cycles passed.
- The final cleaned no-preload build completed three more view-verified cycles, with no BadMatch markers. Full application build/link passed.

The screenshots show the third successful native navigation cycle; still images do not establish GLX correctness by themselves.

![Assembly before Return](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alanbixby/BambuStudio/91aa62a0443203cbf6ab85a61ff1658b4ff0c020/docs/pr-evidence/2026-10-28/native-assembly-roundtrip-3.png)
![Prepare after Return](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alanbixby/BambuStudio/91aa62a0443203cbf6ab85a61ff1658b4ff0c020/docs/pr-evidence/2026-10-28/native-prepare-return-3.png)

These after screenshots show the cleaned combined native build (ELF `88df689cf44a`), not separately rebuilt PRs. title: Publish local Project metadata before optional network lookup
head: 0826d59e1e1b36bf80b82904859c64f339749820
body:
Project information can wait for an optional network lookup or miss the page's initial bridge request. Publish local metadata first, buffer early host messages, and retry the bounded startup handshake. Optional model-link updates preserve an open editor's contents.

Workers use copied inputs, with generation, lifetime and live-project identity checks before publication. Recursive cleanup stays with the Model backup owner; completion checks use a noncreating path accessor. HTTP has 3-second connection and 8-second total limits.

Validation: extracted-method sanitizer tests reproduce cleanup/identity regressions and exercise local publication and selected lifecycle schedules with doubles and disposable files. Reader behavior is tested separately in JSDOM. These do not prove native event-loop race freedom. Portable sources and exact-head logs are included in the linked review evidence.

Empty/failed optional lookups are deliberately retried on later Project visits. The existing blank-page rule for missing title or description remains. Native Windows/macOS rendering and real-thread teardown stress remain untested.

head: b3dacfa61b17385703e700779207e83e0c1041af
body:

title: Fix repeated DPI scaling of native geometry and bitmaps
head: a1b43d73c23d08db6aa19047286c47c51f4cbe38
body:
Merge coordination: Bambu fetches wx master. The companion wx DPI change must wait until every consuming application branch has the corrections below or pins a compatible older wx revision.

Keep measured window/text dimensions in pixels and convert nominal DIP constants once. This corrects the original fourteen geometry sites, 51 additional bitmap, helper and point-font inputs. Icon-bearing inputs change; empty-icon callers retain their existing arguments because they construct no bitmap. Remove fixed progress-label height caps so their natural font height can fit; that row can grow slightly on every platform. Removing double conversions also reduces affected icons, fonts and offsets on Windows above 100% scaling; the bitmap/font input corrections leave macOS identity conversion unchanged.

Adaptive progress messages reserve actual native scrollbar/border space, refresh virtual height, and participate in the initial dialog fit. The message area retains its vertical scrollbar even when the message needs no scrolling. The size override delegates to its direct wxDialog base. Camera status measurement uses the displayed label's font and window context.

Validation: the historical fourteen-site arithmetic harness has 236 assertions; later caller corrections have separate source/unit checks. A private native GTK scroller probe reproduces the original width/scroll-range defect. The follow-up passes 348 initialization/update checks across two themes, three DPIs and both GDK scales; 24 known unbreakable-name failures remain recorded. An existing unbreakable-filename wrapping limitation remains. Windows/macOS compilation and runtime remain unverified.

![Clipped progress digits](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alanbixby/BambuStudio/91aa62a0443203cbf6ab85a61ff1658b4ff0c020/docs/pr-evidence/2026-10-28/printing-progress-user-before.png)
![Unclipped native progress](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alanbixby/BambuStudio/91aa62a0443203cbf6ab85a61ff1658b4ff0c020/docs/pr-evidence/2026-10-28/native-print-progress-height.png)

Companion GTK conversion: [wxWidgets #2](https://github.com/alanbixby/wxWidgets/pull/2). These application changes keep units correct when that conversion is enabled. Other platforms and every remaining DIP caller are not exhaustively tested.

title: Balance the live camera aspect ratio and AMS panel space
head: fab83eef842e6967fa06d0bb05410940b4787d28
body:
Fit the camera to its reported aspect ratio and use the available width to balance the camera and Control columns. Where layout zoom is supported, AMS can grow in bounded 5% steps. Fullscreen exit schedules a fresh fit.

Wait for the native browser backend before querying or applying zoom: WebView2 creation is asynchronous. Keep the initial minimum size synchronized with requested zoom until the page reports its content height. The pinned macOS backend implements magnification rather than layout zoom, so AMS stays unzoomed on macOS; camera aspect fitting still applies.

Independent of #5; both were validated together. Source/backend checks and extracted solver tests cover readiness and platform branches. Historical Linux measurements show the camera/Control alignment. Native Windows/macOS compilation and runtime remain unverified.

Short windows can retain centered Control margins at zoom 1; height shrink can need several settling passes. Stream resolution changes are picked up on a later fit trigger. The patch does not claim one-pass convergence for all sizes.

title: Scale GTK3 DIPs with the current screen font resolution
head: ed8b87d0aa56d9d6e703e617df5e446f85d3ffd4
body:
Merge gate: Bambu fetches wx master. This draft must wait until every consuming branch has the companion consumer corrections or pins a compatible older wx commit. Updating application master alone is insufficient; coordinate release branches before upstream submission or merge.

Make GTK3 DIP geometry follow the current widget screen's font resolution, matching point-sized fonts under fractional font DPI. Preserve unspecified/zero coordinates, prevent small coordinates from becoming sentinels, and saturate before integer rounding. Read the screen resolution per call; no diagnostic override or cached factor is added.

GTK2, Windows and macOS conversion paths are unchanged. This fork deliberately differs from the generic wx contract: FromDIP also follows font DPI, while GetDPIScaleFactor/GetContentScaleFactor continue reporting integer window scale. The interface documentation records that distinction; this change does not redefine those APIs.

Validation: forced font-DPI arithmetic at 96/120/144/192 with GDK_SCALE 1/2, including same-process changes, plus C++98/C++11 range tests. These probes do not establish desktop XSettings normalization or distinct-monitor migration. A private X11/WebKitGTK 2.52.6 rendering probe confirms its existing CSS scaling already matches FromDIP; no extra browser zoom is needed.

![Original sidebar geometry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alanbixby/BambuStudio/91aa62a0443203cbf6ab85a61ff1658b4ff0c020/docs/pr-evidence/2026-10-28/stock-sidebar-cards-before.png)
![Combined native geometry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alanbixby/BambuStudio/91aa62a0443203cbf6ab85a61ff1658b4ff0c020/docs/pr-evidence/2026-10-28/native-sidebar-cards-purge-swatches.png)

[Combined validation record](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alanbixby/BambuStudio/91aa62a0443203cbf6ab85a61ff1658b4ff0c020/docs/pr-evidence/2026-10-28/validation-native.json). Measured pixel values must not be passed through FromDIP again; the companion [application correction branch](https://github.com/alanbixby/BambuStudio/compare/master...fix/native-dip-geometry) corrects the original fourteen geometry sites plus 51 additional bitmap/helper/font callers. Distinct-screen migration, native Wayland and automatic relayout of every existing widget after a setting change are unverified. Fork draft only; upstream submission requires approval.
